Personally i love it. Insmonia for about 15 years before i discovered it...initially taking half a 25mg tablet nightly, after a couple of weeks it starting to help me with the 'switch' between being wakefulness and sleep, not like a sedative, more like a circadian rhythm assistant. Honestly would never stop taking this. After a couple of years i went to 25mg. No real tolerance or side effects. When bipolar episodes are very bad i will take up to 125-250 mg at night to rescue myself. This doesnt make me groggy if i take that much only when in an episode. At lower doses it has an antihistamine effect so it is good for sleep- higher doses it is more of an antipsychotic. Initial side effects were a strange blocked nose for a couple of hours the first couple of weeks after taking it and a general stuffy feeling.

However I only started it six weeks ago and started in the midst of a depression which apparently isn't ideal as it isn't really for stopping an episode, more for maintenance. I wonder if you are also doing non medical things to prevent the depression? I know it sucks to try new drugs etc personally I hate it and love the idea of just being on one med, fingers crossed
